<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>RBI Policy and Growth Outlook:</strong> The Reserve Bank of India kept the repo rate unchanged and projected a real GDP growth rate of 6.9% for the current fiscal year, while announcing a 3 trillion rupee liquidity infusion via OMOs and forex swaps.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxNbUFoX0FtdVltQmREWkx3WDkzdHZpR2RwS1NuS1E1ZzRGTVUtWHBuZXVYSnl3TkRmV1A5NC11S2E5dGtRaFpNdjY0QzhXcVg1akZVVHJOcnkxZFh5R3BzUkctek1JTk9BYWdTM2hpaHJQVmFOb1hGTU5tZHFreW90cy1NeE9PbmlaTEVDUXJ5UTBqck4wX1dBNWt2cTBEdjRRbjNnLUxyTE5kQUdla3EyX0h3?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxOTGFSNzg0VzlJdnMwYWh2TzliX3libXhnd0pFajdsbW05R3dZU3Y5V3BjRU5uV2Q0aDVOZWZNX3dDdHpvNXpGOXRTQlNnQVRScklzNU5QdjVmV2YzOWlFVWZXMXFSZWxscFJIdFY0UHhleHZreWhkRmhqNGpCeTBYTVlpZ3AxcFN5X0h6SkFqSHJzSTBhWER6N1lkQXB3cnlLRXU4TF95ZjNWdC01XzBkTm0zOGN3RmpXc1lQSkdR?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a></span></li>
